feeds.title: APIs You Won't Hate Blog
feeds.description: APIs You won't Hate is a community resource for building and designing and well-crafted APIs. We publish books, articles, podcasts, and a newsletter for API Devs around the world. Phil soon teamed up with cofounder Mike Bifulco, a developer advocate and startup founder, to build the APIs You Won't Hate community.
